title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Premium Travel Benefits and Insurance Coverage
summary: This document details the Business Platinum Rewards Card’s airport lounge access (unlimited visits), $400 in annual travel credits, trip travel insurance (up to $62,500 per trip, activated by eligible card purchases and requiring receipts/quick claim contact), purchase protection (up to $17,500 per claim), and 0% foreign transaction fees for international purchases.
